description:
The repository exposes only the consolidated image and a one-service Compose path, with no active reference to the removed split, CLI, or all-in-one contracts.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `docker/Dockerfile.api`, `docker/Dockerfile.web`, `docker/Dockerfile.cli`, `docker/entrypoint.sh`, `docker/nginx.conf`, and their obsolete runtime configuration are deleted after the replacement image passes smoke.
- [hard] REQ-02: `docker-compose.yml` defines one service that bind-mounts the caller's whole repository at `/repo`, exposes the server and web port, maps explicit `JIT_UID` and `JIT_GID` values to the effective container user, and uses neither a detached named data volume nor a CLI initialization service.
- [hard] REQ-03: `scripts/test-podman.sh`, `scripts/validate-setup.sh`, `INSTALL.md`, `docs/how-to/deployment.md`, and any active README Docker entry point use the supported image and repository-mount contract, show how `JIT_UID` and `JIT_GID` are derived from the repository owner, and explain the fixed `10001:10001` default and its ownership prerequisite in the same change.
- [hard] REQ-04: The container workflow's split-image build jobs and every registry publication job are deleted, so no workflow pushes an image to any registry. Pull-request build and runtime smoke of the one supported image remains.
- [hard] REQ-05: A repository-wide search over tracked active files, examples, and fixtures finds no split image name, removed Dockerfile, entrypoint or nginx path, CLI Docker service, old all-in-one process contract, registry image tag, or Docker `/data` volume instruction. `dev/archive` and incidental storage-test `/data` strings are explicitly excluded.

## Notes

Blast radius: active Docker definitions, the container workflow, scripts, fixtures, and adopter-facing documentation; archive evidence is not rewritten.

Registry publication is removed rather than retargeted: v1.0 publishes one GitHub release and no container registry tag, so the image is something an operator builds from the repository.
title: Remove obsolete Docker topologies and migrate every active consumer
